note: What a server sends its player's champion to have the player draw paths with the mouse. The header names the champion. While on, each right click on the world also sends DrawPath.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: It has no effect.

fields.name: mode
fields.note: Zero to turn drawing off, any other value to turn it on.

revisions.note: A client sets how often a held right click repeats a move to the interval, at least 0.1 seconds, whether on or off.
